about: IsoKron's own fixture servers for the writecheck loop worker (loop/run-items.mjs). A subject listed here runs at the exact npm version given, with its dogfood manifest (the same file, byte for byte, that the dogfood workflow runs) instead of the generic catalog manifest. The manifest is written at /work/m/x/writecheck.yaml and `link` points its relative cwd at the installed package, so the plan is the same as the dogfood one. Where full.plan_hash is set, the full write test runs against a disposable backend inside the sandbox; full.plan_hash is the hash a person read and accepted in dogfood-tiny-tracker.yml or dogfood-kronicle-lite.yml for the same server version, manifest and CLI. A plan that gives another hash is recorded as drift and the full run does not start. known_answer names the tiny-tracker defect the shard's known-answer control switches on. Change only by a reviewed commit.

kronicle-lite.subject: isokron-ai/kronicle-lite
setup:
set -e; mkdir -p /work/out/kl-data /work/out/kl-seed; printf '# Dogfood guard

This store belongs to one CI job and is thrown away after it.
' > /work/out/kl-seed/guard.md; printf '# Bystander one

Not created by the tester.
' > /work/out/kl-seed/by1.md; printf '# Bystander two

Also not created by the tester.
' > /work/out/kl-seed/by2.md; node "$1/dist/cli.js" put dogfood-guard /work/out/kl-seed/guard.md --title 'dogfood guard'; node "$1/dist/cli.js" put dogfood-bystander-1 /work/out/kl-seed/by1.md --title 'bystander one'; node "$1/dist/cli.js" put dogfood-bystander-2 /work/out/kl-seed/by2.md --title 'bystander two'
